sentences.en: A squirrel scampered across the road and bounded up a tree.
sentences.zh: 一只松鼠穿过马路，迅速蹿上了一棵树。

sentences.en: The boys scampered in all directions at the sight of their teacher.
sentences.zh: 学生们一看到老师就四散跑开了。

sentences.en: The fox scampered off after a few seconds.

senses.zh: 蹦蹦跳跳；奔跑，惊惶奔跑
